question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Amubi Singh has conferred the award for his significant contributions in which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__***.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Guru Amubi Singh, who was credited with pioneering solo dance in** Manipuri**, was the first winner of the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** award from the state of M**anipur which he won in 1956.**
 
• Manipuri dance is well known and very famous throughout the country and abroad.
 
• Guru Amubi was appointed as the surpervisor of the Academy.
 
• Guru Amubi was a man of personality and principles, who could speak Hindi and Bengali fluently.
 
• He was awarded with** 'Nritya Guru' Award in 1954 by the Manipuri Sahitya Parishas, Bharat Rastrapati Award in 1956 and Padmashree Awarded in 1970**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shovana Narayan is a recognised Indian Kathak dancer **and a career officer with Indian Audit and Accounts Service.
 
• **He was a descendant of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers, which includes his two uncles, Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj, and his father and guru, Acchan Maharaj.**
 
• Saroja Vaidyanathan was conferred the **Padma Shri in 2002 and the Padma Bhushan in 2013 by the Government of India.**
